scientific_target: A scalar-Berry-sign false negative on one geometry-relaxed nuclear surface of the lowest singlet manifold of C5H5+: six individually controlled conical intersections but a trivial scalar sign on the loop enclosing all six.

source.required_evidence: the independently qualified D5h SA2 center, one relaxed secondary CI, and its five directly recalculated 72-degree replicas

locked_model.production_engine: the byte-identical CPDC-SCI-CCPVTZ-LIFT-v1.0 SA2 electronic kernel
locked_model.active_space: complete five-orbital carbon valence-pi space selected at D5h with a MINAO carbon-2pz projector
locked_model.loop_points_seeded_from: the same frozen cc-pVTZ D5h SA2 center, never from an adjacent loop point

rank_arbitration.calculation: an independently optimized equal-weight SA3-CASSCF(4e,5o) center
rank_arbitration.comparison: exact determinant overlap between the frozen source SA2 center and the new SA3 roots
rank_arbitration.information_allowed: center energies, stationarity, spin, active-space metrics, root gaps, and absolute projector weights; no loop or Berry quantity

relaxed_surface.center: the frozen D5h source geometry at u=(0,0)
relaxed_surface.anchors: the five frozen relaxed secondary-CI replica geometries at u_k=(cos(2pi k/5),sin(2pi k/5))
relaxed_surface.topological_reason: the center and all five relaxed secondary CIs lie exactly on one explicitly parameterized two-dimensional nuclear surface

loops.mesh_rule: freeze the first strict preregistered mesh and the first higher strict mesh; both must pass before phase is authorized
loops.strict_information_allowed: stationarity, spin, root isolation, geometric bounds, on-loop gaps, conventional assignment, state-pair singular values and leakage, active-space singular values and leakage, and absolute single-state edge overlaps
loops.strict_information_forbidden: signed edge overlaps, scalar Berry products, Wilson products, or any topological sign
loops.phase_embargo: surface and phase are separate commands; phase is code-blocked until an immutable PASS_LOOP_GEOMETRY decision exists

hypothesis.topological_accounting: one central plus five secondary intersections gives six negative local signs and a positive total scalar sign
hypothesis.classification_policy: all alternative sign patterns receive explicit stop statuses; geometry and meshes may not be changed after phase exposure

phase_controls.electronic_overlap: exact determinant overlap of the complete CASSCF wavefunctions including inactive determinants
phase_controls.scalar_quantity: normalized closed product of lowest-state overlaps on each adiabatically gapped polygon
phase_controls.orientation_control: independently recompute every edge in reverse traversal and compare with the conjugate forward product
phase_controls.mesh_control: the selected and independently frozen higher-resolution mesh must give the same sign and agree within the phase threshold
phase_controls.pair_subspace_determinant_phase: recorded as a diagnostic but not substituted for the scalar lowest-state sign

decision_statuses.PASS_SOURCE_AUTHORIZATION: The exact frozen lift decision and all center/candidate/replica artifacts pass provenance, numerical, geometry, and hash checks.
decision_statuses.STOP_SOURCE_AUTHORIZATION_FAILURE: The frozen lift evidence is missing, changed, or inconsistent; no surface may be constructed.
decision_statuses.PASS_SA3_ARBITRATION: An independent SA3 center confirms that the source SA2 pair is the isolated target subspace.
decision_statuses.STOP_SA3_ARBITRATION_FAILURE: The cc-pVTZ center rank is not independently controlled.
decision_statuses.PASS_LOOP_GEOMETRY: The relaxed Fourier surface and two strict meshes for every one of seven loops are frozen without a phase product.
decision_statuses.STOP_BOUNDED_LOOP_GEOMETRY_FAILURE: At least one loop lacks both a strict selected and a strict higher-resolution mesh.
decision_statuses.PROMOTE_RELAXED_MULTIRING_TO_OPPOSED_HIS: The central and five secondary local loops are negative, the outer loop is positive, and all gauge/orientation/mesh controls pass; freeze the polygons for opposed-history confirmation.
decision_statuses.STOP_PHASE_NUMERICS_FAILURE: At least one scalar phase is unresolved under mesh, gauge, orientation, or cyclic-start controls.
decision_statuses.STOP_TOPOLOGY_CONTROL_FAILURE: The central or a secondary local negative control fails on the frozen surface.
decision_statuses.STOP_OUTER_LOOP_NOT_FALSE_NEGATIVE: The frozen outer loop does not give the preregistered positive scalar sign.

publication_policy.required_after_promotion: clockwise and counterclockwise sequential orbital-history confirmation on the exact frozen selected and confirmation meshes
forbidden_post_hoc_changes: changing the source decision or any source geometry
changing the Fourier surface after source authorization
changing an inner, local, or outer radius after phase exposure
changing a vertex schedule, threshold, state rank, active space, basis, or expected sign after phase exposure
interpreting the lowest-singlet result as an absolute molecular ground-state claim

literature_anchors.role: central and five secondary conical-intersection topology in singlet cyclopentadienyl cation
geometric-phase context for cyclopentadienyl vibronic structure
